notes.title: Announcement of an Upcoming Game Update (Coming Soon)
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209960/94cffad78bce5d1e389772c2f479cfcec9fc3723.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209960/b5e83820ee1e120dc900bb95cbffa1716795df4a.jpg[/img][/url]

We are planning an upcoming update that will adjust the abilities of many cards.

Currently, cards with direct attack have been particularly strong in the meta, so we’re planning to buff the abilities of other cards to create a more balanced environment. Stay tuned and look forward to it!

notes.title: Ver. 1.24 has been released!
notes.content:
We have released an update that includes several fixes.

Feature Improvements
Improved the pacing of battles.

Rule Changes
Adjusted the unit play order, which was previously dependent on card set order, to make it clearer:
(Your back → Opponent's back → Your middle → Opponent's middle → Your front → Opponent's front)

Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where the opponent's spell usage did not visually reduce their hand size.

Fixed desynchronization issues in replays. (Due to rule changes, replays from previous versions are no longer compatible.)

Fixed a bug where spell images remained displayed when using Kyoko's effect to cast a spell twice.

Other Fixes
Adjusted effects for some cards.

notes.title: Ver. 1.23 has been released!
notes.content:
Adjusted the card pool for Shield Battles.
Fixed an issue where player life changes caused by certain card effects were not updating correctly.
Clarified that starting a Shield Battle requires a 50 yen fee.
Improved the card text for 'Minoriko' to make it clearer.
Fixed an issue where retiring from certain story battles still counted as a clear.
Corrected typos in the scenario text (Japanese).

notes.title: Version 1.22 has been released.
notes.content:
Thank you for playing!
We are releasing an update with some feature improvements and bug fixes.

Updates & Fixes:
You can now proceed to the next battle in Ranked Matches without returning to the home screen.
Improved error messages for stories with deck composition restrictions to make them clearer.
Fixed an issue where the background would disappear if you selected a story and then played a battle in a different mode.
Fixed a display issue with some of the newly added player icons.

notes.title: Bug Fix Announcement
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the home screen display appeared incorrect or certain features were unavailable depending on story progress.

notes.title: Announcement of a Major Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209960/c35beb2a401a9dc4469b2794fe5489d82b5922e2.png[/img]

Thank you for playing!
The wait is over—we've released an update alongside the Spring Sale that includes new cards!

・New Cards Added
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209960/ec56053d0d681d2f8602dea2441389c2b77c48b3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209960/f26db50e493c721d1af3ff1702427a15dbc59956.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209960/b3383817fe2b7b8eaead14ab784f92254056b609.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209960/d848b20bea07f60c5fd2e78bcfbd4faccfd73587.png[/img][/url]

By opening card packs, you can now use Vol.4 cards.
Try out the unique new cards!
Over 30 new cards have been added!

・A New Story Too?
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209960/ec56053d0d681d2f8602dea2441389c2b77c48b3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209960/f26db50e493c721d1af3ff1702427a15dbc59956.png[/img][/url]
There seems to be a condition to unlock it.
Could it be related to card packs?

・A New Ranked Season Has Begun
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209960/62f9d275ff80f925037c5aaffb61518e38a7e86d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209960/3535be01e500ccbd19ff53db3558379c993e2b59.png[/img][/url]
Build a deck with the new cards and take on Ranked Matches!
Your previous wins are now recorded in a new total victory ranking.

Other Fixes and Adjustments
Card packs are now included as rewards in Shield Battles.
New cards have been added to Shield Battles.
Some abilities of old cards have been adjusted.
Various bug fixes.

notes.title: Version 1.08 Release & Upcoming Card Update Announcement
notes.content:
Thank you for enjoying Fairy Card Battlers!
We are releasing a version update with bug fixes and feature enhancements.

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where AI card plays became abnormal as battles progressed.
[*]Improved the replay screen.
[*]Spells are now played and activated during the Spell Phase:
[/list]

The Spell Phase occurs before the Battle Phase. Spells are played and resolved after units are played.
This change does not affect gameplay behavior but improves clarity and supports future card additions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209960/16bc236ec197c681d31c016c1f38447c5c6bcd28.png[/img]


Additionally, we are planning an update soon that includes new card additions.
Here’s a sneak peek at some of the upcoming cards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209960/5361a374acbbc98537878c9c23c5b3a63ff17889.png[/img]

notes.title: Minor adjustments
notes.content:
Version 1.07

notes.title: Announcement of New Features
notes.content:
Thank you for playing our game!
We’ve implemented a few exciting features that we hope you’ll enjoy.

Ver 1.05
- Added the ability to rematch the same opponent in ranked matches
- Added the ability to view your own rank in the ranked match leaderboard

Now, your rank will appear in the leaderboard screen as shown below.

notes.title: Update Announcement (Ver 1.03)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209960/d937cad5c51c2188f2944fc1be3a22e49ac8f5d8.png[/img]
We've released an update that includes several requested features, along with improvements to the UI and translations.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209960/b35fd8149b4889e38c2f376d7d0247bd7ec4ca40.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209960/5fc0cba6a823c8a5f54549bf3642bad1331d786a.png[/img][/url]


Ver 1.03
- You can now check the total number of cards owned from the player information screen.
- Some card illustrations have been updated.
- "Online Battle" has been renamed to "Ranked Match".
- Allow players to check the board state while choosing their turn-start bonus.

Ver 1.02
- Minor adjustments to the menu UI display.
- Adjusted the position of cards in hand when hovered over.
- Updated English story text.
